asset.display_name: Invesco/Superstate Short Duration U.S. Government Securities Fund

publication_status.label: LIVE
publication_status.summary: Live on X Layer mainnet + testnet
publication_status.reason: Verified signed reports are retained with publication transactions on X Layer mainnet and testnet.

asset.identity_basis: ERC-20 token contract on Ethereum mainnet, address taken from Superstate's own documentation
asset.identity_caveat: Superstate reuses the same address across chains, so an asset key is only meaningful as the pair (chain, address).

publisher.relationship_to_asset: fund manager and issuer of the published data
publisher.authority_note: First-party issuer disclosure. This is not an independent attestation, an audit, or proof of reserves.

sources.timezone: not stated by the source; row dates carry no timezone and are treated as calendar dates
sources.revision_semantics: The newest rows are provisional. The feed publishes a row for the current date carrying the previous values forward and rewrites it later. Verified by differing the two retained captures: the 08/12 and 08/13 rows changed while 952 older shared rows did not.
sources.failure_semantics: A retrieval or parse failure is SOURCE_ERROR and never an assertion about the issuer. Absence of a row for today means the feed has not published, not that the fund has no NAV.
sources.retention: Every retrieved artifact is stored content-addressed and never deleted; two captures at least 24h apart are required before any value is observed.

sources.timezone: as_of_date is an ISO calendar date with no timezone
sources.revision_semantics: not observed to revise; only two captures exist, so this is unproven
sources.failure_semantics: SOURCE_ERROR on retrieval or parse failure

sources.timezone: as_of_date is MM/DD/YYYY with no timezone
sources.grace_period_basis: provisional; the true cadence has not been observed long enough to derive it
sources.failure_semantics: SOURCE_ERROR on retrieval or parse failure

limits.redirect_policy: same host and HTTPS only, at most one hop, and the target must be the source's own URL or one of its declared redirect_aliases — a redirect to a different approved source is refused (PLAN-T5)
limits.decompression: Accept-Encoding: identity is requested and a non-identity Content-Encoding is refused; conflicting duplicate Content-Type or Content-Encoding headers are refused (PLAN-T5)

terms_of_use.researched: docs.superstate.com publishes these endpoints in a full documentation export and exposes a Swagger UI, both of which present the API as public. No usage terms, rate limit or robots restriction specific to api.superstate.com was located.
terms_of_use.residual: Absence of a located restriction is not permission. A human must confirm the terms before any production or commercial dependence.

residual_checks: Repeated retrieval from the production host has not been performed; all probes ran from a development machine (PLAN gate G2).
The relationship between the API's outstanding_shares and onchain token supply is not established, so no supply control is enabled.
